fatal_errors: The proposed WC interlayer does not match the target CrFeTaVW and CrFeTiVW high-entropy alloys.
WC is confused with the tungsten-carbide milling media used during mechanical alloying.
The claimed diffusion-barrier and enhanced-thermal-conductivity mechanisms are unsupported and do not reflect the target mechanism of disorder-limited thermal transport.
explanation: The hypothesis recognizes the general W–CuCrZr interlayer problem and proposes a testable comparison against direct contact, but it reconstructs neither the studied materials nor their processing, structures, mechanisms, or outcomes. The target evaluates equiatomic CrFeTaVW and CrFeTiVW alloys, produced by mechanical alloying and spark-plasma sintering, as candidate interlayer materials. Their multielement disorder yields thermal diffusivity substantially below W and CuCrZr, while Ta-to-Ti substitution changes phase constitution with little effect on diffusivity. WC appears only as milling media in the target and is not supported as the interlayer material.
